coverage.summary: Covers residential rental property in Santa Ana once a tenancy passes 30 days. Excluded: housing produced in the last 15 years (a rolling exemption, not the rent cap's February 1, 1995 cutoff), deed-restricted affordable housing, hotel and transient occupancy, hospital and care facilities, dormitories, and other shared living quarters.

result.notes: I changed requires_unknown_facts to false. The ordinance covers ordinary residential rental property; its exemptions are carve-outs, not a limitation to an unidentifiable class of buildings. I expanded unverifiable_exemptions to include all listed exemptions an address lookup cannot reliably confirm: deed-restricted, hotel/transient, hospital/care, dormitories, and shared living quarters. I set supersedes_state_rule to null and removed the Civ. Code § 1946.2 comparison from the summary, because no document mentions the state rule or a binding finding of greater protectiveness. I left construction_cutoff null because the 15-year exemption is rolling, with its reference date and record unstated; it is captured in new_construction_exemption and min_building_age_years.
